story.title: Gemini Robotics 2 brings whole body intelligence to robots

draft:
I'm intrigued by Gemini Robotics 2, which enables robots to learn whole-body intelligence. 
This tech allows robots to adapt to new situations and environments. 
Key benefits include improved flexibility and autonomy. 
What implications will this have on the future of robotics? 
#AI #Robotics #GeminiRobotics2
